correctness.rationale: For all integer n>=4 and 2n(n-1) normalized D_n roots, the degree-three normalized Gegenbauer kernel k_n(t)=((n+2)t^3-3t)/(n-1) follows from harmonicity and k_n(1)=1. Distinct roots have dot products in {0,+/-1/2}, and the sign-summed coordinate matrix satisfies X^T X=2(n-1)I; matching entries yields K=3(n+2)/(2(n-1))(P_odd-P_coord)+(n-4)^2/(2(n-1))P_coord. Eigenvalue multiplicities n(n-2),n and even nullity n(n-1) follow. For n>=5, coefficient parameters q_(i|j)=a_i+b_ji span all odd root data by solving (n-4)a_i=sum_{j!=i}q_(i|j); exactly squarefree cubics vanish. At n=4 the row-sum constraints remove n=4 coordinate modes, rank eight, and add four u_i(u_i^2-sum_{j!=i}u_j^2) kernel cubics. Eigenvalues coincide iff (n-4)^2=3(n+2), giving n=10 as the only n>=5. Independently checked exact full kernel matrix entry identities across n=4,5,6,7,10 with 24..180 signed roots, including n10 K=I-J; the algebraic proof, not finite dimensions, handles all n.
